title: Habitica Quest Damage Contribution Balance
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:habit party_member=* quest_damage=*
| stats count as items by party_member
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how quest actions split across party member for party quest contribution.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside party quest contribution.
implementation: Capture each quest actions event in `lifeos:habit` and normalize `party_member` so Splunk can compute the share by party member.
visualization: Table of party member with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how quest actions are divided across party member so you can tell if one part of party quest contribution is taking over.
